response.sql: WITH per AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE -amount END) AS avg_signed_amount, COUNT(*) AS txn_count FROM trans GROUP BY account_id) SELECT account_id, avg_signed_amount, txn_count, txn_count * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(txn_count) FROM per) AS ratio FROM per ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Every type other than 'PRIJEM' (including VYDAJ and VYBER) is negative, as the request states; a NULL type would also be treated as negative.
The average transactions per account is total transactions divided by the number of distinct accounts in trans, which is the average of the per-account counts.
